subject: Gerudo Valley Canyon
text: Link can cross the fallen bridge over the canyon in Gerudo Valley by jumping with Epona or pulling himself over with the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Go up the log bridge near the entrance of the Valley, and when you reach the fallen bridge spanning the canyon, either use Epona to jump over the gap or the Longshot to pull yourself over.

subject: Carpenter
text: The Master Carpenter waits on the far side of the canyon and explains that his assistants were captured after running off to join the Gerudo Thieves.

evidence.quote: If you speak with the Carpenter on the other side of the canyon, he'll report that he came to the Valley to repair the bridge.  But, his assistants ran off to join the Gerudo Thieves, and were captured.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula is found on the wall behind the Carpenter's Tent, reachable with the Longshot.

evidence.quote: There is a Gold Skulltula on the wall behind the Tent.  Kill it and take it's token with the Longshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: At night, another Gold Skulltula is located on the back of the natural stone arch opposite the Carpenter's Tent.

evidence.quote: Head south to the wall opposite the tent, where there is an arch formed from the natural stone.  Look on the back of the arch to see another Gold Skulltula (it has to be nighttime).  Kill the Skulltula and take it's token with the Longshot.

subject: Gerudo Guards
text: If Link is spotted by patrolling Gerudo guards, he is captured and thrown into a prison cell.

evidence.quote: Climb up the stairs, where you will find purple-suited Gerudos patrolling the area.  Allow one of them to see you, and you will be thrown into a prison.

subject: Prison Cell
text: Link can escape the prison cell by hooking the wooden awning high above the south window with the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Look south in the prison cell, and look high on the wall to find a window.  Pull yourself up to the window by shooting the wooden awning with the Longshot.

subject: Gerudo Guard
text: Patrolling Gerudos can be stunned with arrows, or temporarily with the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Stun the Gerudo closest to this door with an arrow (you can use the Longshot if you run out of arrows, but it doesn't stun the guards for nearly as long), then quickly jump down from the window sill and into the door before the Gerudo recovers.

subject: Gerudo Thief
text: When a Gerudo Thief crouches and spreads her swords apart, she is preparing a stun attack that will send Link back to the prison cell if it hits.

evidence.quote: You'll know that the Gerudo is going to do this when she crouches slightly and holds her swords far apart.  If you get hit by this attack, you will instantly lose the fight and return to the prison cell back in the Fortress.

subject: Gerudo Thief
text: Defeating the Gerudo Thief guarding Ichiro's cell yields a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Once the Gerudo Thief is defeated, take the Small Key she leaves behind and open Ichiro's cell.

subject: Ichiro
text: Link frees the carpenter Ichiro by unlocking his cell with the Small Key dropped by the Gerudo Thief.

evidence.quote: Once the Gerudo Thief is defeated, take the Small Key she leaves behind and open Ichiro's cell.  Run inside and speak with him to free him.

subject: Gerudo Guard
text: Using Z-Focus to peek around corners allows Link to spot a rooftop Gerudo guard and shoot her in the back with an arrow.

evidence.quote: Peek around the corner using the Z-Focus maneuver you learned back in Sacred Forest Meadow, and you'll see a patrolling Gerudo Guard.  Wait for her to face away from you, then nail her in the back with an arrow.

subject: Gerudo Thief
text: Defeating the Gerudo Thief near Sabooro's cell provides a Small Key used to unlock the cell.

evidence.quote: Defeat the Gerudo Thief that appears, and then open Sabooro's Cell.

subject: The Kitchen
text: In the Kitchen, Link can stun both guards with arrows and cross the room using Hover Boots.

evidence.quote: Shoot both of the guards in the room with arrow to stun them, then equip the Hover Boots.  Use them to run out to the ledge directly in front of you from the doorway.  From the ledge, run across to the ramp on the other side of the kitchen.

subject: Fortress Roof
text: Climbing the ivy around the corner of the adjacent rooftop leads to the top level of the Fortress.

evidence.quote: Jump over the gap here to the adjacent roof, then around the corner to find a wall covered with ivy.  Climb the ivy to the top level of the Fortress.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula clings to the east wall of the northern roof and can be killed and collected using the Longshot.

evidence.quote: When you reach the north end of the roof, you will see an adjacent roof with a chest sitting on it.  If it's nighttime, then you will also see a Gold Skulltula clinging to the wall on the east side.  Use the Longshot to kill it and take it's token.

subject: Rooftop Chest
text: A chest containing a Piece of Heart sits on an isolated roof that Link can reach by targeting it with the Longshot or summoning Pierre with the Scarecrow's Song.

evidence.quote: The gap between the roofs is too far to jump, so use the Longshot on the chest to pull yourself over to it (the Longshot's range is just barely far enough to reach it).  Alternatively, you can also use the Scarecrow's Song to make Pierre appear, presenting a closer target....Open the chest to get a Piece of Heart, then play the Sun's Song to warp back to the doorway from the Kitchen.

subject: Gerudo Thief
text: Defeating the Gerudo Thief by Jiro's cell yields a Small Key to unlock his cell.

evidence.quote: Take the Small Key that the Gerudo Thief leaves behind, then open the Jiro's Cell.

subject: Jiro
text: Link opens Jiro's cell with the Small Key and speaks with him so he can escape.

evidence.quote: Take the Small Key that the Gerudo Thief leaves behind, then open the Jiro's Cell.  Speak with him, and he'll escape.

subject: Gerudo Thief
text: Defeating the Gerudo Thief near Shiro's cell awards a Small Key used to open the cell.

evidence.quote: Use the Small Key that the Thief drops to open Shiro's cell, then run inside and speak with him to free him.

subject: Gerudo Lieutenant
text: After Shiro is freed, a Gerudo Lieutenant appears and presents Link with the Gerudo Membership Card.

evidence.quote: After Shiro is freed, a Gerudo Lieutenant will appear and speak with you.  She is so impressed by your abilities to sneak around the Fortress, that she'll make you an Honorary Gerudo Thief, and present you with a Gerudo Membership Card.

subject: Gerudo's Membership Card
text: The Gerudo Membership Card allows Link to roam Gerudo's Fortress freely without harassment, opens access to the Gerudo Training Ground, Horseback Archery Range, Haunted Wasteland gate, and sees the Gerudo Valley bridge repaired.

evidence.quote: This Card does many things.  For one, it lets you move around Gerudo Fortress freely without the guards harassing you.  It also lets you access the Gerudo Training Ground and the Horseback Archery Range, letting you win the Ice Arrows (Gerudo Training Ground), the Biggest Quiver, and a Piece of Heart (both from the Horseback Archery Range).  The Card's most important function, however, is that it lets Link open the gate in the northwest end of the Fortress, letting him access the Haunted Wasteland, the Desert Colossus and the Spirit Temple.  Also, the bridge back in Gerudo Valley is now repaired.

subject: Sabooro
text: Defeat the Gerudo Thief that appears, open Sabooro's Cell, and speak with him again to free him.

evidence.quote: Defeat the Gerudo Thief that appears, and then open Sabooro's Cell.  Speak with him again to free him, then head back out of the cell.
